summary: Steam Big Picture and Playnite Fullscreen are now free, alongside the Xbox full-screen experience. Custom launchers, Resource Control and Session Tweaks remain Pro.
notes: Steam Big Picture and Playnite Fullscreen are now available without Pro, alongside the Xbox full-screen experience.
Custom launchers, Resource Control and Session Tweaks remain Pro features.
More reliable launcher ownership: CouchMode closes only the session it started and leaves a launcher you were already using alone.
Improved Steam Big Picture and Playnite handling, including sessions you started yourself.
Improved built-in and external controller classification using device topology rather than manufacturer.
Controller presence is now reported the same way everywhere, so a gamepad that cannot start a session is explained rather than shown as connected.
Clearer guidance for controllers Windows does not expose as Xbox controllers.
Improved Resource Control and after-session action reliability.
General reliability and diagnostics improvements.
knownIssues: Devices can only be released from the PC they are on; there is no in-app option to sign out of all devices.
Experimental: Xbox Full-Screen Experience depends on Windows system behavior. On some devices, controller navigation may not receive focus automatically and may require pressing the Xbox button once.

summary: Plug in a controller and Steam Big Picture, Playnite or the app you chose opens full screen; unplug it and CouchMode closes the session and brings the desktop back.
notes: Improved Xbox full-screen detection across desktop PCs and Windows handhelds.
Fixed cases where supported devices could incorrectly appear as unsupported or require repeated verification.
Improved reliability when entering, leaving, and returning from Xbox full-screen sessions.
Improved detection of built-in and external controllers, including external controllers that could be treated as integrated handheld controllers.
Improved desktop restoration after a gaming session; CouchMode now avoids unnecessarily changing windows that are already accessible.
Improved diagnostic information available with bug reports.
Improved update-state handling and general reliability.

summary: Plug in a controller and Steam Big Picture, Playnite or the app you chose opens full screen; unplug it and CouchMode closes the session and brings the desktop back.
notes: Steam Big Picture, Playnite fullscreen and a custom app of your choice are sessions CouchMode owns: they close reliably when the controller disconnects, and the desktop comes back.
The return to the desktop is verified on every exit, not assumed.
Optional Resource Control closes the apps you selected for the session and reopens them afterwards. It works from a list frozen before the session starts, so nothing you open later is ever touched.
General reliability improvements for Pro access, membership checks, and startup licensing.
Pricing, the 7-day trial, offline grace, tiers and device limits are unchanged.
